title: Tiny, cute hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Top glass -->
  <polygon points="30,15 70,15 55,45 45,45" fill="#b3e5fc" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Bottom glass -->
  <polygon points="45,55 55,55 70,85 30,85" fill="#b3e5fc" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Top sand -->
  <polygon points="38,22 62,22 53,42 47,42" fill="#ffb74d"/>
  <!-- Bottom sand pile -->
  <polygon points="35,85 65,85 55,65 45,65" fill="#ffb74d"/>
  <!-- Falling sand -->
  <rect x="49" y="43" width="2" height="18" fill="#ffcc80"/>
  <!-- Top cap -->
  <rect x="26" y="10" width="48" height="7" rx="3" fill="#ff8a65"/>
  <!-- Bottom cap -->
  <rect x="26" y="83" width="48" height="7" rx="3" fill="#ff8a65"/>
  <!-- Cute eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#4dd0e1"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#4dd0e1"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="49.5" r="1" fill="#e0f7fa"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="49.5" r="1" fill="#e0f7fa"/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="54" rx="3" ry="1.8" fill="#ff8a80" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="54" rx="3" ry="1.8" fill="#ff8a80" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M45,56 Q50,60 55,56" stroke="#4dd0e1" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Wood grain accents -->
  <line x1="30" y1="13" x2="70" y2="13" stroke="#ffab91" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="86" x2="70" y2="86" stroke="#ffab91" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
